cells.tense: You are standing on the cleared ground with your hand still on the pen.
cells.act: stay with the quiet of it
cells.ask: Find an hour this week and keep it quiet — nothing to solve, nothing to file. Whatever you already recognise gets to be recognised. At the end, don't move it into a plan.
cells.core:
You have gone far enough into this that structures built on what couldn't hold have come apart, and you're standing on the cleared ground with your senses about you. The depth is honest and not performed. The clearing stays shared, too — understanding that lands between people, each one still whole in it, the tables solid enough to eat at.

What holds the space open is quieter than thinking: a recognition that settles and stays, connection that doesn't fuse. So find an hour this week and keep it quiet — nothing to solve, nothing to file. Whatever you already recognise gets to be recognised, and stays where it is. At the end, don't move it into a plan. The hours kept unfused are what the cleared ground costs to keep.

cells.tense: You will be bracing for the timbers to fall before the collapse has finished.
cells.act: put the frame on the table before anyone asks
cells.ask: When the next structure starts to give, say its shape aloud — one plain sentence, what is standing, not why. Say it before the asking starts, then let it sit there.
cells.core:
The dissolution isn't shocking enough, so you will race ahead of it. You will reorganise what is shaking before it finishes shaking, prop the timbers mid-drop, and call the scramble seeing clearly. What you're protecting is the depth itself, not losing ground already found. Rushing the rebuild usually means the second structure fails faster, and the ones standing beside you can feel the speed.

Your check here is to claim the frame in the open rather than hold it inside your own head. When the next structure starts to give, say its shape aloud — one plain sentence, what is standing, not why. Say it before the asking starts, then let it sit there. Things get clear for the people nearby, and you stop carrying the scaffolding alone.

cells.tense: You are still at a doorway that is no longer there to stand in.
cells.act: mark the good thing together, out loud
cells.ask: When something good happens near other people, say so in the moment, out loud, once. No retelling afterward and no lesson drawn. The saying is the whole act.
cells.core:
The clear ground is behind you and you haven't walked out onto it. You still talk about the collapse as a tent you're living under, and your hand stays on what's already dust. The thing your depth is for — shared ground, understanding that passes between people and stays alive — sits on the far side of a door you keep shut.

What's starved is belonging, so feed gladness instead of insight. When something good happens near other people, say so in the moment, out loud, once. No retelling afterward and no lesson drawn. The saying is the whole act. Speaking the good thing while it's happening gives the next piece of understanding somewhere real to land.

cells.tense: You have already crossed over something and haven't said so.
cells.act: spend an hour with the thing you love without a task attached to it
cells.ask: Give an hour to something you love with no use made of it. Write one line about what moved in you — not why, not the story. That line is the acknowledgment, kept where you can see it.
cells.core:
The crossing is behind you and it is not in what you tell people. You say work got complicated, or that project wore you out. What moved was larger, and the version offered onward is smaller than the movement was. People stand beside someone who crossed and are handed someone keeping a straight face. The false structure dropped; what they haven't heard is that it fell by your own hand.

Give an hour to something you love with no use made of it. Write one line about what moved in you — not why, not the story. That line is the acknowledgment, kept where you can see it. The change doesn't need to make sense to anyone first; it needs to be seen as yours.
